outline:
先修課程：負責教授同意
材料機械性質是強調材料巨觀性質與材料微觀結構, 鍵結及晶體結構之間的關係, 是一門實務性,基本且重要的課程。它包括彈性, 塑性行為, 差排理論, 單晶與聚晶材料之塑性變形, 複合材料, 高溫聚晶材料之變形, 非晶質材料之永久變形, 材料強化機構, 材料破壞, 潛變與氫脆性等問題之討論。
This course deals with the mechanical behavior of materials. It emphasizes the relationship among macroscopic properties, material microstructure, and fundamental concepts of bonding and crystal structure. Contents of this course include the elastic and elastic behavior , dislocation , plastic deformation in single and polycrystalline materials ,strengthening mechanism of crystalline materials, composite materials, high temperature of crystalline materials ,fracture , fatigue and embrittlement.
schedule:
Week 1: 引言Introduction (1)
Week 2: 變形物理Physics of Deformation (2)
Week 3: 機械測試與材料特性Mechanical Testing & Properties of Materials (3)
Week 4: 金屬/合金之強化機制Strengthening Mechanisms in Metals/Alloys (4)
Week 5: 工程材料Materials in Engineering (5)
Week 6: 應力-應變關係及變形模型Stress-Strain Relations & Deformation Models (6)
Week 7: 彈性及黏彈性Elasticity & Viscoelasticity (7)
Week 8: 複雜/主應力及應變Complex/Principal Stresses & Strains (8)
Week 9:	期中考Midterm Exam
Week 10: 塑性及超塑性Plasticity & Superplasticity (9)
Week 11: 軸件扭矩Torsion in Shafts (10)
Week 12: 失效理論及設計Failures Theories & Design (11)
Week 13: 破裂力學及設計Fracture Mechanics & Design (12)
Week 14: 材料疲勞行為Fatigue Behavior of Materials (13)
Week 15: 材料潛變形為Creep Behavior of Materials (14)
Week 16: 複合材料機械行為Mechanical Behavior of Composite Materials (15)
Week 17: 複習Reviews
Week 18: 期末考Final Exam
